name: Fact Check
title: Fact Check | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Give every claim its own hearing.
description: Check assertions against evidence, one claim at a time. Fact Check returns individual verdicts with the reasoning and sources behind each one.
caption: Workflow illustration.
flow_title: From assertion to an auditable verdict.
flow_intro: Check assertions against evidence, one claim at a time. Fact Check returns individual verdicts with the reasoning and sources behind each one.
steps: Supply the specific assertions you want checked before sharing a draft or making a decision.
Weigh evidence for each claim without letting one result stand in for the others.
Follow each verdict to its sources, or reuse evidence from a previous research run.
detail_title: Expertise your agent can put to work.
details: Distinguish supported, refuted, unverifiable, and opinion in the returned verdicts.
Each claim carries its reasoning and source references for inspection.
Check claims against evidence Deep Research has already gathered.
prompt: Use Fact Check to review these claims. Read fact-check --help and check configuration. Evaluate each claim independently, then return the verdict, reasoning, and sources for each one.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+ and uv. The configuration guide covers evidence backends, model providers, and shared research runs.
model_note: Checking new claims uses configured evidence and model services. Reading and filtering saved verdicts need no model call.
